The power sector is booming, yet REC and PFC stocks have fallen sharply from their all-time highs. So, what’s driving this disconnect?
In this video, we explain the key factors behind REC and PFC’s performance, including rising competition from banks and NBFCs, slower loan-book growth, rising prepayments, and the impact of improving asset quality on earnings.
